watches.name: An Evening at F1 Arcade
watches.description: Lights out and away we go! To get things started for this year’s Owners weekend, we’re heading to F1 Arcade, which opened in River North this summer. We’ve booked a semi-private room for an evening of full-motion F1 simulator racing on some of the world’s most famous tracks, with food and drinks included. No racing experience required. watches.name: The Humboldt GMT 2026 Chicago Edition
watches.description: Created exclusively for Chicago Windup, this special edition Humboldt GMT is limited to just five pieces. Featuring a black PVD bezel insert and an exclusive Chicago-themed caseback engraving, it's a subtle tribute to the city we call home. Swiss-powered, anti-shock, anti-magnetic, with a GMT function, all housed in a brushed stainless steel 40mm case with a bi-directional bezel and 20ATM water resistance. Available on our fully articulated stainless steel bracelet with quick-adjust clasp. Overview T he anti-fragile, anti-worry, go anywhere and do anything watch. Swiss-powered, anti-shock, anti-magnetic, GMT function all in a brushed stainless steel 40mm case with a bi-directional bezel and 20ATM water resistance. Built to Discover. Powering the Humboldt GMT is the Swiss-made Sellita SW3 3 0, a rugged and reliable movement that combines time-tested dependability and remarkable accuracy. A quick-set adjustment allows you to independently set the 24-hour hand to simultaneously track multiple time zones. With a power reserve of 56 hours, quick-set date, 25 jewels and our iconic 4-star rotor all tucked in securely behind a protective solid caseback, we’re confident this movement will live up to the demands of the Humboldt GMT Owner. Our stainless steel bracelet sits comfortably on the wrist with a fully articulated link design that gradually tapers from the 20mm solid end links to the 16mm buckle. The bracelet has 7 removable links and a six position quick-adjust, locking clasp. Yup, that means no tools required to adjust the fit on the fly! The bracelet will fit wrists from 6.3 inches to 9.1 inches (160mm - 231mm). watches.name: The Humboldt ExP-02
watches.description: We’re excited to introduce the second watch in our Experimental Series, the Humboldt ExP-02! Horology is a bit of both art and mad science, and our Experimental Series is all about the “mad science” part. For this limited production Humboldt, we’re pushing the limits of our in-house production. We produced both the dials and bezels ourselves to create a sleek, capable tool watch with a refined, monochromatic design that showcases our commitment to craftsmanship. Laser light is used to cut the dials before they’re sandblasted to achieve a stunning matte grey finish. Each dial is then marked with a “ghost script” that shines or vanishes depending on the light. The watches are fitted with a fixed steel bezel machined right in our Chicago HQ on our trusty shop lathe. The intensive, hands-on production process results in watches that are as singular as the individuals who wear them . Learn more about the Humboldt ExP-02 Overview T he Experimental Series is a line of watches that allows us to explore different techniques and expand our horological chops. That can mean new metals, heat treatments, unique dial materials—nothing is off limits. This is the second watch in the series, and with it, we’re pushing the boundaries of our in-house production capabilities even further. While the first ExP model was forged in fire, this one is cut by light itself. This one-of-a-kind Humboldt features a unique grey dial that sets it apart in the Oak & Oscar collection. Each dial is machined in our Chicago HQ using our very own 100 watt MOPA fiber laser. The chapter ring, hour markers, hand holes, and positioning holes are all cut with powerful laser pulses. The dials are then sandblasted and marked with laser light resulting in a “ghost script” that shines or vanishes depending on the light. The Humboldt ExP-02 features a fixed steel bezel that is machined by our watchmaker on a Schaublin 70 lathe. Each bezel is precisely bored to fit perfectly onto the watch case. The handcraft involved in producing the Humboldt ExP-02 means that it’s a limited production piece. We’ll make more in the future; these watches just take more time to produce than our regular production models. The Humboldt ExP-02 is presented on our precision-designed, tapered (20mm-16mm), brushed stainless steel bracelet with solid, fully articulated links. A secondary orange nylon strap comes with the watch that makes for a really sharp contrast that’s sure to turn some heads. The initial run of the Humboldt ExP-02 was limited to just twenty examples. Ten watches were reserved exclusively for Owners, and ten were reserved for the general public. Each set was made available through a lottery system . Specifications Sellita SW300 automatic mechanical Swiss movement Fixed stainless steel bezel made in-house at our Chicago HQ Matte gray dial laser-cut at our Chicago HQ 56-hour power reserve 28,800 bph / 4 Hz 39.5mm diameter case with drilled lugs 20 ATM water resistance (200 meters / 660 feet) 12.4mm case height 20mm lug width 46.8 mm lug-to-lug Double-domed sapphire crystal with multi-layer anti-reflective coating Exhibition caseback with sapphire crystal Hands applied with Super-LumiNova BGW9 Two-year limited warranty A portion of all Oak & Oscar profits donated to local Chicago dog rescue, One Tail at a Time Included Humboldt ExP-02 Stainless steel bracelet 20mm nylon strap Waxed canvas watch wallet

watches.name: The Olmsted Windup Edition
watches.description: The Olmsted Windup edition commemorates ten years of both Oak & Oscar and Windup with a special caseback and engraving made right in our Chicago HQ. These watches are limited to just five pieces and will be available exclusively at Windup NYC ! Overview The Olmsted 38 is a classic, automatic winding, 38mm field watch with a two-layer sandwich dial, 10 ATM (100m / 330ft), screw-down crown, and inner minute track with orange cardinal numeral accents. The Olmsted 38 takes its namesake from conservationist and founder of landscape architecture, Frederick Law Olmsted – an avid believer in the need of natural public space in society. Olmsted is responsible for designing many of the public parks in the United States; notably, Central Park in New York City, and Jackson Park in Chicago. Throughout a fascinating life, Olmsted pushed for the protection of Yosemite Valley, created the parkway, the integrated park system, and founded the precursor to the Red Cross. The engine powering The Olmsted Windup Edition is the Sellita SW300, a legendary, Swiss-made, solid workhorse of a movement customized with our iconic 4-star rotor design – a subtle nod to our hometown of Chicago. Our stainless steel bracelet sits comfortably on the wrist with a fully articulated link design that gradually tapers from the 20mm solid end links to the 16mm buckle. The bracelet has 7 removable links and a six position quick-adjust, locking clasp. Yup, that means no tools required to adjust the fit on the fly! The bracelet will fit wrists from 6.2 inches to 9.1 inches (158mm - 231mm). watches.name: The Atwood Wind Vintage Edition
watches.description: Working with good people to build great products is what Oak & Oscar is all about. The limited edition Atwood Wind Vintage Edition marks a collaboration borne out of years of friendship and mutual admiration between Eric Wind, founder of Wind Vintage, and Chase Fancher, founder of Oak & Oscar. Wind Vintage is the premier dealer of vintage timepieces at all pricepoints. Designing a watch that reflected the aspects of vintage watches that Eric loves while also maintaining Oak & Oscar’s unique design language and commitment to modern capability was a fun challenge, and the result speaks for itself! This is a watch we’re extremely proud of, and it’s sure to become a collector’s item in its own right. The Atwood Wind Vintage Edition is a 39mm, manually wound, flyback chronograph with a blued column wheel and 58-hour power reserve. It is available on our fully-articulating, stainless steel bracelet with quick-adjust clasp. If you'd like to add our classic, Horween leather strap you can find it here . The Atwood Wind Vintage Edition is limited to only 25 pieces and is in stock and ready to ship! Sold out! In less than 2 minutes! Wow. Thank you! EXPLORE THE ATWOOD WIND VINTAGE EDITION ⟶ Overview Taking our Signature Collection chronograph as its starting point, the Atwood Wind Vintage features a proportionate 39mm case, pump pushers, flyback functionality, and a blued column wheel visible through a sapphire caseback. The watch is powered by the innovative AMT5100M caliber, a product of Sellita’s bespoke AMT Manufacture division—a high-end experimental group like Mercedes’ AMG or BMW’s M program. The AMT5100M is a manually-wound column wheel, flyback chronograph caliber with a robust 58-hour power reserve and 23 jewels. The oversized crown makes winding the chronograph a real joy. The Atwood Wind Vintage was designed with collectors of both vintage and modern watches in mind. The warmth of the stone grey dial looks great on the wrist. Instead of the traditional tachymeter scale, this watch has a base 15 pulsometer scale printed in blue along the white rehaut, a charming callback to chronographs of the past. Bright bursts of orange and blue emerge from the depths of the watch’s sandwich dial construction. The dial is double signed with the Oak & Oscar logo printed in blue under the 12 o’clock index and the Wind Vintage logo printed in orange just above the subdial at 6 o’clock. The stainless steel portion of the caseback is also engraved with both the Oak & Oscar and Wind Vintage logos. The watch is offered on our precision-designed, tapered (20mm-16mm), brushed stainless steel bracelet with solid, fully articulated links. The bracelet has 7 removable links and a six-position quick-adjust, locking clasp and will fit wrists from 6.2 inches to 9.1 inches (158mm-231mm). Free domestic shipping via UPS! Specifications Sellita AMT5100M mechanical Swiss movement with 23 jewels Manually wound Flyback with blue column wheel 58-hour power reserve 28,800 bph / 4 Hz 316L Stainless steel 39mm case diameter 12.9mm case height (including the domed crystal) 5 ATM water resistance (50 meters) 20mm lug width 46.0mm lug-to-lug Double-domed sapphire crystal with multi-layer anti-reflective coating Sandwich dial with Super-LumiNova BGW9 Two-year limited warranty * International buyers are responsible for any customs duties Included The Atwood Wind Vintage Edition Stainless steel bracelet 20mm tan khaki nylon strap with orange stitching and signed hardware Canvas watch wallet American-made strap changing tool

watches.name: The Humboldt GMT SAR
watches.description: This limited edition timepiece is a collaboration between Oak & Oscar and the brave men and women of the St. Louis County Rescue Squad. The Rescue Squad patrols northern Minnesota’s majestic Boundary Waters Canoe Area (BWCA) and the entire St. Louis County region. The important and lifesaving work performed by this dedicated group of volunteers requires rugged, well-designed precision instruments. With a lightweight, titanium case, 20 ATM (200m) water resistance, anti-mag and anti-shock technology, and a ceramic compass bezel insert, the Humboldt GMT SAR Edition is built to withstand the tough conditions encountered by the Rescue Squad. SOLD OUT! Holy moly...! In just a few short days the entire lot these amazing watches have sold out. Thank you so much to everyone! EXPLORE THE HUMBOLDT GMT SAR ⟶ Overview The limited edition Humboldt GMT SAR Edition is the result of an exciting collaboration between Oak & Oscar and the dedicated men and women of the St. Louis County Rescue Squad. This group of volunteers provides invaluable and sometimes lifesaving services to people visiting northern Minnesota’s Boundary Waters Canoe Area (BWCA) and the entire St. Louis County region. The Humboldt GMT SAR Edition is equipped for whatever the wilderness throws at you. The titanium case mitigates extreme temperatures and is light on the wrist. The ceramic compass bezel features a generous application of lume so you can find your way out of trouble in even the blackest of nights. The GMT complication allows you to simultaneously track two time zones. And the anti-shock and anti-magnetic technology protect your watch from impacts and harmful magnetic fields. This watch is built to withstand even the toughest conditions. Powering the Humboldt GMT SAR is the Swiss-made Sellita SW330 , a rugged and reliable movement that combines time-tested dependability and remarkable accuracy. A quick-set adjustment allows you to independently set the 24-hour hand to simultaneously track multiple time zones. With a power-reserve of 56 hours, quick-set date, 25 jewels, and our iconic 4-star rotor all tucked in securely behind a protective, solid caseback, we’re confident this movement will live up to the demands of the Humboldt GMT SAR Owner. The Humboldt GMT SAR features our custom designed rubber strap with topographic ventilation channels and engineered comfort ridges. Outfitted with a titanium buckle and made from high quality rubber, these straps are built to withstand extreme conditions and stay comfortable on your wrist A portion of the profits from the sale of this watch will be donated to the St. Louis County Rescue Squad. The watch is presented on an orange rubber strap and is a limited edition of 50 pieces. Free domestic shipping via UPS! Specifications Sellita 330 automatic 25 jewel mechanical Swiss movement Scratch resistant, lumed ceramic compass bezel Anti-magnetic enclosure Anti-shock bumper technology 56-hour power reserve 28,800 bph / 4 Hz Grade 5 Titanium case and bezel 39.5mm case diameter with 40.0mm bezel 120 click, bi-directional bezel with ceramic ball bearings 20 ATM water resistance (200 meters) 12.5mm case height 20mm lug width 46.8mm lug-to-lug Double-domed sapphire crystal with multi-layer anti-reflective coating Color-matched date wheel with custom typeface located at 6 o'clock S andwich dial with Super-LumiNova BGW9 20mm rubber strap with titanium buckle 20mm canvas strap with titanium buckle Canvas watch wallet Two-year limited warranty Limited edition of only 50 pieces * International buyers are responsible for any customs duties Included The Humboldt GMT SAR 20mm rubber strap with titanium buckle 20mm canvas strap with titanium buckle Canvas watch wallet Strap changing tool

watches.name: The Atwood
watches.description: Whether you go for the traditional panda dial or a reverse panda, our signature high-contrast, bold colors make sure your watch stands out from the crowd. Pair the Atwood with jeans and a t-shirt, a flame-retardant racing suit or a nice suit. It's got that perfect blend of modern style and vintage vibes. Comes on our fully articulated steel bracelet with a quick-adjust clasp, with a nylon strap in the box. Overview The Atwood is a 39mm, manually wound flyback chronograph with a blued column wheel, a 58-hour power reserve and a classic tri-compax layout. At just 12.9mm to the top of the double-domed crystal, it's our slimmest chronograph yet. Inside is the AMT5100M, from Sellita's AMT Manufacture division, their high-end experimental group (think Mercedes' AMG or BMW's M program). It's a manually wound, column-wheel flyback caliber with 23 jewels, and you can watch it work through the sapphire caseback. Our signature sandwich dial gets a twist here: the subdials sit down in the lower layer, giving the dial real depth, with a wrapped tachymeter scale around the rehaut that goes to 54 units. It's also the first Oak & Oscar chronograph on a steel bracelet. A portion of all Oak & Oscar profits goes to One Tail at a Time, a Chicago dog rescue. watches.name: The Olmsted FEW Edition
watches.description: This limited edition watch has been in the works for a couple of years. In fact, we've wanted to do something like this since before the launch of our very first watch back in 2015. As a watch lover and a bourbon lover, this feels like the perfect collaboration. And we're absolutely honored to have partnered with our friends, FEW Spirits. The Olmsted FEW edition features our classic 38mm field watch case, signature sandwich dial for added depth and legibility, screw down crown and 100m water resistance. Inspired by the FEW color palette, this Olmsted features our very first deep salmon dial . A beautiful matte finish that pairs wonderfully with the included Horween leather strap. What really sets this collaboration watch apart is what's in the backside. Yup, this limited edition watch features an actual piece of a bourbon barrel in the caseback . And not just any bourbon barrel, it's from the same barrel used to age the Bottled in Bond, single barrel picked exclusively by the Oak & Oscar team. The folks who purchase the Olmsted FEW edition (and who are 21 or older and legally able to receive a bottle…) will be gifted a bottle of bourbon aged in precisely the same oak wood that’s displayed in the caseback. Each Olmsted FEW is hand-assembled, tested and regulated at our Chicago headquarters by our in-house watchmaker. The Olmsted FEW edition is available on our handmade, Horween leather strap that tapers from 20mm to 18mm. Want a stainless bracelet too? Shoot us an email and we can update your order! The Olmsted FEW Edition is available to ship now and will make a great holiday gift ! EXPLORE THE OLMSTED FEW ⟶ Overview Our watches are hand-assembled, tested, and regulated at our Chicago headquarters by our head in-house watchmaker and Director of Watchmaking, Nathan. We’re very proud to continue the tradition of watchmaking here in the US and are dedicated to the art, craft, and a little touch of mad science that is horology. The engine powering the Olmsted FEW is the Sellita SW300; a legendary, Swiss-made, solid workhorse movement customized with our iconic 4-star rotor design, a subtle nod to our hometown of Chicago, hidden behind the wooden coin. The Olmsted FEW comes on our handmade, Horween leather strap. We’re proud of our Horween leather straps and the craftsmanship that goes into them. From the hand-beveled edges with applied water-based dye to the hidden orange stitching on the floating keeper, our leather strap tapers from 20mm to 18mm at the buckle for a comfortable fit. The Olmsted FEW Edition is available to ship now and will make a great holiday gift! watches.name: The Olmsted ExP-01
watches.description: Introducing a new series of watches from Oak & Oscar; the Experimental Series! Our team is always pushing the boundaries of watchmaking and watch design, and a few ideas make it to production. For the first watch in the Experimental Series, you might say we wanted to see how our Olmsted watches worked in the most extreme environments. Like...I don't know...being dropped into a volcano. These copper, bronze-colored watches are absolutely beautiful—especially paired with our dark green, no date dial. They’re part of our horological journey, and aren’t perfect, but dang it they’re incredible and truly unique! The different surface colors, all due to a chemical reaction, are a reminder of just how cool discovering new techniques can be. Learn more about the Oak & Oscar Experimental Series Overview This is the first timepiece in our Experimental Series, where we experiment with new, innovative techniques to play, have fun, and expand our horological chops. Our watches are hand-assembled, tested, and regulated at our Chicago headquarters by our head in-house watchmaker and Director of Watchmaking, Nathan. We’re very proud to continue the tradition of watchmaking here in the US and are dedicated to the art, craft, and a little touch of mad science that is horology. Each Olmsted ExP-01 watch includes a 20mm canvas strap, which is tapered and includes an 18mm, heat treated, stainless steel buckle with a tang that is engineered to sit level with the buckle. The buckle is signed on both the top and bottom and has a grooved channel on the underside to allow the strap to sit more flush and comfortably on the wrist. Canvas is a natural material. Your strap will age and develop its own patina over time. We're doing it the right way, not the easy way. All of those extra steps mean that Experimental Series watches are limited production pieces. Not limited edition—we won't be cutting these off at a specific serial—but we just can't crank 'em out the way we'd like for regular production. The Olmsted ExP-01 is only available at Windup Watch Fair Chicago July 14 - 16, 2023. watches.name: Raffle Ticket - Olmsted 200 NAOP
watches.description: We love Frederick Law Olmsted around here at the Oak & Oscar HQ. So much so that we named a watch after him. And would you believe it? There's an entire organization dedicated to Olmsted. Yup, the National Association for Olmsted Parks (NAOP) helps to preserve the legacy of the Olmsted family for future generations. Want to know something even cooler? They love our Olmsted watch and asked us to help them celebrate Olmsted's 200th birthday. What. An. Honor. This year, in what would have been his 200th year, the NAOP is celebrating the legacy of Frederick Law Olmsted through a series of events and fundraising for the Olmsted parks around the country. We're absolutely honored and thrilled to have created three unique, double-signed dials with a custom engraved caseback. Two of these are awarded to recognize exemplary leadership in championing Olmsted's work and principles. The third watch is being raffled off by us for $50 a ticket, with all the proceeds going directly to NAOP. So yeah, you can purchase a $50 ticket (heck...grab ten of them!) and have a shot at winning an extremely unique and cool timepiece. Winner will be notified via email by the end of November! Please note that this raffle is for US residents only. Value of the watch is estimated at $1,950. Other rules and regulations apply, please email for more information. The Olmsted 38 takes its namesake from conservationist and founder of landscape architecture, Frederick Law Olmsted – an avid believer in the need of natural public space in society. Olmsted is responsible for designing many of the public parks in the United States; notably, Central Park in New York City, and Jackson Park in Chicago. Throughout a fascinating life, Olmsted pushed for the protection of Yosemite Valley, created the parkway, the integrated park system, and founded the precursor to the Red Cross. The engine powering The Olmsted 38 is the Selitta SW300, a legendary, Swiss-made, solid workhorse movements customized with our iconic 4-star rotor design – a subtle nod to our hometown of Chicago. watches.name: The Humboldt Seven Year
watches.description: Like a distillery that has had time to craft an exceptional aged bourbon, we’re releasing the Humboldt Seven Year to highlight what we’re capable of making. The Humboldt Seven Year celebrates our seventh year in business and showcases what we can do and why we're one of the best small independent brands out there. With a hand-cut brass bezel, hand-finished dial and a sandblasted rotor we are confident that the Humboldt Seven Year combines true craftsmanship with our iconic design. These were available only at the 2022 Chicago Windup! EXPLORE THE HUMBOLDT SEVEN YEAR ⟶ Overview To build the Seven Year, Nathan Bobinchak, our Director of Watchmaking, is individually hand-machining bezels out of a special brass alloy for a watch that looks like nothing else we’ve ever made. It’s out first two-tone watch, but it’s brass, not bling. Brass is typically called a “base” metal, but it forms the base of almost everything in the watch, from the dials and hands, to the geartrain, to the movement plates and bridges. It’s the building block of horology, and we’re not afraid to show it off. The bezels are precisely hand-cut to fit the case, with tolerances that are barely a fraction of a human hair. Each piece is individually made on a vintage Derbyshire Elect lathe that used to maintain timepieces at the U.S. Naval Observatory. We’re stripping away the decoration to show the raw materials that make our watches special. Each dial on the Seven Year is painstakingly turned to reveal the metal beneath, and the rotors are sandblasted to highlight their multi-part construction. The bezel is made from 693 Eco Brass, a special lead-free alloy with exceptional corrosion resistance and strength. That means it’s safe to wear, and hard enough to withstand your adventures. Each watch will patina uniquely to you. The brass is completely untreated, which means it will start changing the moment you put it on. Each bezel will have your unique “fingerprint” of patina! watches.description: To celebrate our partnership with Team Shuster as they defend their Olympic gold, we’re releasing an incredibly limited edition of the Humboldt 12-Hr—the same watch they’re wearing on the ice right now at the 2022 Beijing Winter Games—with a piece of a real curling stone from an Olympic competition set into the caseback. The craftsman single-handedly transforms the stone from a massive hunk of granite into precise, watch-size discs. The caseback stones are held in a hand-machined stainless steel setting, made right here in our Chicago headquarters. Each steel setting is machined by Nathan on a vintage Derbyshire Elect lathe, cut and bored with a hand-ground tungsten carbide cutter to tolerances of just hundredths of a millimeter. Because of the sheer amount of work that goes into each of these watches, this is an extremely limited run of just ten pieces; five are for Team Shuster and five for the public. It’s truly a remarkable feeling watching them compete while wearing something we’ve created. What better way to celebrate our partnership, Team Shuster, and the winter sport we’ve all fallen in love with, than by wearing a little bit of curling on your wrist? watches.description: Wow. All Big Eyes were sold nine minutes after the launch...crazy. If you missed the Big Eye and want to stay in the loop and learn more about our next release mack sure to sign up for the newsletter. Subscribe here. The design of our Big Eye is striking—its orange accents around the minute track and charming asymmetrical face not only make this limited edition timepiece unique but also make it easier to read. We’ve even removed the date for a cleaner, more focused design. Go ahead, time those ribs on the grill. Want to know how long you’re wheels up on a transatlantic flight? No problem with the Big Eye thanks to the stacked register that tracks both elapsed minutes and hours. The vintage charm and simplicity of two subdials without the clutter and busyness of three subdials. Love at first click. The pusher action of the Jackson Big Eye is satisfying and sharp thanks to the column wheel mechanism. The unique flyback complication allows for instant restarts from zero with a single press of the lower pusher. Asymmetrical in all the right ways. The Jackson Big Eye was limited to only 50 pieces. watches.name: The Jackson - PVD
watches.description: - SOLD OUT! - The charcoal PVD is limited to only 100 pieces. The dark case, light colored tachymeter and charcoal grey dial create a striking design that will surely turn heads. The charcoal PVD model will be an instant classic. Learn more about the Jackson. Overview The Jackson Chronograph is a 40mm, manually wound, flyback chronograph with a 60 hour power reserve, date at 6 o'clock, and a stacked register at 3 o'clock that tracks both minutes and hours. The timepiece features a column wheel activated chronograph for crisp pusher action and accurate timing. The Eterna Movement Company's caliber 3916M powers the Jackson Flyback Chronograph. With a 60 hour power reserve, stacked register and a column wheel activated chronograph complication this specialized movement is a true work of art. Specifications Manual wound flyback chronograph with column wheel and stacked register 60 hour power reserve Eterna Caliber 39 manual wound 25 jewel mechanical Swiss movement (Cal. 3916M) 28,800 vph / 4 Hz Stainless steel, 40mm case diameter and 14.5mm case height 20mm lug width 46.4mm lug-to-lug Double-domed sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating Light grey, wrapped tachymeter scale Color-matched date wheel with custom font located at 6 o'clock 5 ATMs water resistance (50 meters) Brushed baton indices with Super-LumiNova BGW9 Two-year limited warranty Limited Edition; 100 PVD pieces * International buyers are responsible for any customs duties Included Jackson Chronograph Tapered, 20mm Horween leather strap with signed buckle Tapered, 20mm Horween orange leather rally strap with signed buckle Modular leather watch wallet to hold three watches in detachable suede pouches and strap tool. Made of Horween and Tasman leather. Custom American-made strap changing tool

watches.name: Bracelet Upgrade
watches.description: Available as an upgrade to folks with the Humboldt or Olmsted on leather. Our stainless steel bracelet sits comfortably on the wrist with a fully articulated link design that gradually tapers from the 20mm solid end links to the 16mm buckle. Ready to tackle the elements. The bracelet has 7 removable links and 5 micro-adjustments on the locking clasp. The bracelet will fit wrists from 6.1 inches to 9.1 inches (158mm - 231mm). If you need an extra short bracelet, shoot us an email and we can make it happen!
